query: I was out walking my golden retriever this morning and he ended up chasing a squirrel right into a patch of wild blackberries, so I had to spend twenty minutes picking thorns out of his fur and wiping purple berry stains off his paws when I got home. Then I remembered I still need to order that custom phone case I’ve been eyeing with the constellation print, I just can’t decide if I want the matte finish or the glossy one that glows in the dark. I also just finished baking a batch of chocolate chip cookies, they’re still warm on the counter and I swear they turned out chewy just the way I like them for the first time ever. Anyway, I’m having some issues with my phone: my APN settings seem to be all messed up, my line got suspended because I have an overdue bill and my contract just ended, my SIM card is locked with a PIN I can’t remember right now, and I think the SIM card might have gotten unseated when I tripped over the dog earlier. I really need help fixing this so I can use my phone again.
